'''November 2000 Minneapolis tournament (28 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 28 November 2000. [[Michael Raveling]] won it. It is known from Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1500">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-28-mirkwood-minnesota-2000d1500/ mirkwood-minnesota-2000], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 28 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-28-mirkwood-minnesota-2000d1500/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
